title: Edwards EVOQUE Eos MISCEND Study
brief_summary: Study to evaluate the safety and performance of the Edwards EVOQUE Eos mitral valve replacement system
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Clinically significant, symptomatic mitral regurgitation
* High risk for open-heart surgery
* Meets anatomical criteria

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unsuitable anatomy
* Patient is inoperable
